summary: Focused re-test of the cookie-session fallback for GET /api/mod/site/attachments/serve. Backend: 12/12 pytest pass. JWT query -> 200; cookie only -> 200; token=cookie + cookie -> 200; bad token + cookie -> 200; no token/no cookie -> 401; token=cookie with no cookie -> 401; other-org cookie and other-org JWT -> 403; path outside mod-attachments or with '..' -> 400; missing file -> 404. UI with a real MOD login form (localStorage.token === 'cookie'): both thumbnails issue-attachment-thumb-fault-photo-0/1 load (naturalWidth 40, the real size of the seeded image), the src has no token param, both issue-attachment-open-* links return 200 image/webp, and opening one in a new tab also returns 200 image/webp. The MODSiteDashboard viewerUrl pattern (&token=cookie) loads in the browser (200, naturalWidth 40). At 390px: no horizontal overflow (scrollWidth 390), open icons sit inside their rows, names truncate with an ellipsis and the meta line sits below them, the same as in iteration_296. The iteration_296 401 bug is fixed.

minor.issue: The ?token= JWT path calls verify_token only. It does not check is_jwt_revoked or that the user is active. Reproduced: after POST /api/auth/logout, the same JWT used as ?token= still returns 200, while the same value sent as a cookie returns 401. This was already the case before this fix. Suggest checking is_jwt_revoked(payload['jti']) and user.active in the query-token branch.

action_items: (Minor, security hardening) Add the revocation and active-user check to the ?token= branch of mod_attachment_serve

(Info) MODSiteDashboard is only lazily imported as _MODSiteDashboard in routes/AppRoutes.js and is not mounted on any route, so FaultCard viewerUrl cannot be reached in the UI. Its URL pattern (token=cookie) was checked by building the URL in the browser instead. Either remove the dead page or route it.
critical_code_review_comments: mod_attachment_serve: the query-JWT branch skips revocation (is_jwt_revoked) and active checks, so a logged-out JWT still works until it expires
The auth check (401) runs before the path check (400), so an anonymous request with a bad path gets 401. That is acceptable.

MODSiteDashboard.viewerUrl still appends &token=<localStorage token> (='cookie'). It works because of the backend fallback, but it would be cleaner to match IssueDetailPanel and drop the param when the token is 'cookie'.
The seed's clean() removes DB rows but not the two stored TEST_295_photo*.webp objects in object storage. They are harmless, but they are left behind.
seed_data_creation: Ran backend/tests/_seed_fault_photos_295.py seed before testing and clean afterwards (0 TEST_295 users/orgs/issues left). No emails sent.
context_for_next_testing_agent: /api/auth/login needs portal:'mod' for MOD users and is rate-limited (~a few attempts/min, returns 'Too many requests'). To run the regression: seed, then export REACT_APP_BACKEND_URL and run pytest tests/test_mod_attachment_serve_297.py, then clean. In the UI login, localStorage.token is 'cookie'. The thumbnail src has no token param and loads via the ga_session cookie.
rca of the issue: iteration_296: real logins keep only the 'cookie' sentinel, so the serve endpoint got token=cookie and returned 401. Fix verified: the endpoint now falls back to try_get_current_user (cookie) when the token is missing or 'cookie'.
